description: This file defines the TransUnit class within the OrangeHRM installer utility namespace. It serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) encapsulating translation unit data with properties for target and unit ID, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: TransUnit
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a translation unit, with properties for target text and unit identifier, including constructor and accessor methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TransUnit object with optional target and unitId values.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit identifier of the translation unit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit identifier of the translation unit.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the target text of the translation unit.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the target text of the translation unit.
